name: BabyDoge FarmZAP arbitrary-farm and auto-liquidity manipulation
summary: FarmZAP trusted a caller-supplied farm contract, approved it for swap output and did not verify that depositOnBehalf settled the tokens. The attacker combined that access to fee-exempt swaps with BabyDoge's unbounded internal swapAndLiquify sell to manipulate the BABYDOGE/BNB price and extract BNB.

loss.notes: Both components measure attacker proceeds after every loan and borrow was repaid inside the exploit transaction, net of identifiable attacker-supplied inputs; financing fees, builder payments and gas are not added back. 2023-05-28: the attack helper 0x51873a0b615a51115f2cfbc2e24d9db4bfa2e6e2 holds no native BNB before the transaction and exactly 437.123093519995276290 BNB after the flash loan is repaid. 2023-06-21: helper 0x9a6b926281b0c7bc4f775e81f42b13eda9c1c98e sweeps 441.905957368884914737 WBNB to attacker EOA 0xee6764ac7aa45ed52482e4320906fd75615ba1d1 in the last call of the transaction, of which 0.001500057464032669 WBNB is the helper's own pre-funded seed and is deducted, leaving 441.904457311420882068 WBNB. That figure reconciles with the victim side: the BabyDogeSwap pair is depleted by 454.222711001031799752 WBNB less flash fees of 7.496201410465721525 and 4.822052278730673748 WBNB. Remaining attacker inputs on that leg, 986809918461 BABYDOGE base units and 4e9 BabyDogeSwap LP units, are together under 1e-9 BNB and are not deducted. No component is counted by another record.

ageReset.description: FarmZAP was deployed with the arbitrary-farm callback and approval behavior. The directly executed runtime remained byte-identical immediately before the incident.
The direct BabyDoge token was deployed with the internal swapAndLiquify path. Its runtime remained byte-identical immediately before the incident.

limitations: Not the knot: an independently sufficient defect whose age reset precedes target-1's; the sibling with the latest age reset supplies the incident's single observation.

sources.note: Reviewed the exploit transaction, receipt and full call trace; adjacent-block native and token balances; both target creation transactions and receipts; historical runtimes; verified contract metadata; the commit-pinned reproduction; and two technical incident analyses. The attacker calls FarmZAP 0x451583b6da479eaa04366443262848e27706f762 three times through selector 0xb87785b5. FarmZAP queries the attacker helper as IFarm, swaps into its own balance, approves that helper and calls its no-op depositOnBehalf, after which the helper uses transferFrom to recover the output. The same trace repeatedly executes BabyDoge token 0xc748673057861a797275cd8a068abb95a902e8de and triggers its internal router calls during swapAndLiquify while the Pancake pair price is manipulated. FarmZAP is a direct 12,714-byte contract created in transaction 0x2e2792453a521f89de736a27086dacdbea78d0304eb8cb377953c02ede8c07c7:31; no DELEGATECALL is exercised by it in the exploit, and its deployment and pre-exploit runtimes hash to 0x891aa451167773220a29584cba5e04143f6ebd0ce213cdc02df427d649698389. BabyDoge is a direct 11,178-byte contract created by factory 0xf103d2aba493749a402b7de11cf31f5844062b74 in transaction 0xb3787e14ca6d6662e97148f37d8f1512eafc94496c237def9bbff3d073ef3937:174; its deployment and pre-exploit runtimes hash to 0xf267028176840847b59638fb29923b617f85eae9696c6182ee407a1cba3e0cd9. The attack helper's native balance changes from zero at block 28593354 to 437.123093519995276290 BNB after the anchor, following flash-loan repayment.

Knot attribution. FarmZAP's untrusted-farm callback and the BabyDoge token's unbounded swapAndLiquify sale are two independent defects executed by the anchor transaction, not one conjunctive failure: the 2023-06-21 recurrence merged into this record extracted 441.904457311420882068 WBNB from the same token runtime while paying ordinary BabyDogeSwap and PancakeSwap fees and never calling FarmZAP, so the token sale is profitable to trigger without fee-exempt access. Each target is separately sufficient and each is reviewed evidence. The single knot follows the latest age reset: FarmZAP was deployed 2022-10-21, 18906952 s (218.8 days) before the anchor, against the token's 2021-05-21 deployment at 63622237 s (736.4 days), so target-1 is curve-eligible and target-2 is not. This supersedes the conjunctive-failure reasoning previously recorded at this source id.

Merge review of the 2023-06-21 BabyDoge exploit into this record. Transaction 0xbaf3e4841614eca5480c63662b41cd058ee5c85dc69198b29e7ab63b84bc866c succeeds at block 29295011:86, timestamp 1687350214, sent by 0xee6764ac7aa45ed52482e4320906fd75615ba1d1 to helper 0x9a6b926281b0c7bc4f775e81f42b13eda9c1c98e behind a transfer(0x4f3126d5de26413abdcf6948943fb9d0847d9818,1) entry point. eth_getCode keccak for 0xc748673057861a797275cd8a068abb95a902e8de is 0xf267028176840847b59638fb29923b617f85eae9696c6182ee407a1cba3e0cd9 at blocks 7607365, 28593354 and 29295010, so the runtime that failed on 2023-05-28 is byte-identical to the one that failed on 2023-06-21 and the June transaction is a recurrence of failure:babydoge-unbounded-auto-liquidity-swap, not a new incident. The defect is CoinToken._transfer calling swapAndLiquify(numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity) on any transfer whose sender is not uniswapV2Pair once balanceOf(address(this)) reaches the threshold, with swapTokensForEth passing amountOutMin 0 and addLiquidity passing 0 and 0. Storage slot 21 holds 0x2c781f708c509f400000 (2.1e23) and slot 19 holds swapAndLiquifyEnabled true, both unchanged from deployment to block 29295010; uniswapV2Router 0x10ed43c718714eb63d5aa57b78b54704e256024e and uniswapV2Pair 0xc736ca3d9b1e90af4230bd8f9626528b3d4e0ee0 are immutable and live in the runtime; only owner (slot 0), the fees (slots 15-18, 3 to 5) and _maxTxAmount (slot 20, 2.1e24 to 3e26) moved, all size-only, so no causal configuration change resets either exploit. The 666 SwapAndLiquify logs the token emitted between blocks 7921058 and 29295011 all sell exactly 105e21 base units; realised BNB per token runs 3.6e-3 to 1.3e-2 through 2022 and 2023 and the only outliers are 2.0902e-3 (2023-05-28, 219.470602145517302825 BNB) and 1.7529e-3 (2023-06-21, 184.058856964612679327 BNB), the two lowest and the last two events in the series, which separates the defect from market movement. In the June transaction the attacker moved pair 0xc736ca3d9b1e90af4230bd8f9626528b3d4e0ee0 from 28046.549880102720166192 WBNB and 4.730513927540743416049435e24 BABYDOGE to 15370.323287488300389571 and 8.641645379215733246249469e24, topped the token's own balance to exactly 210000000000000000000000, and fired the sale with a one-unit transfer. Netting the receipt's 118 logs: token contract 0xc748673057861a797275cd8a068abb95a902e8de -202648391392823466814133 BABYDOGE to a zero balance, liquidity wallet 0x505d1180061727c59ce04e7acfc117283cf797f0 +3714.887861595936299290 CAKE-LP, BabyDogeSwap pair 0x0536c8b0c3685b6e3c62a7b5c4e8b83f938f12d1 -454.222711001031799752 WBNB, flash fees +7.496201410465721525 WBNB to 0x16b9a82891338f9ba80e2d6970fdda79d1eb0dae and +4.822052278730673748 WBNB to 0x58f876857a02d6762e0101bb5c46a8c1ed44dc16, attacker EOA +441.905957368884914737 WBNB. The Venus leg is not a victim: the vBNB borrow of 99463.293771243647112315 BNB is repaid to the wei and the vUSDT and vBUSD collateral is redeemed in full, and the PancakeV3 USDT/BUSD flash loan is repaid with its fee.

notes: The seed row's $7.5 million value belongs to the Jimbo Protocol exploit reported on the same date. This BabyDoge transaction's exact net proceeds are 437.123093519995276290 BNB, consistent with contemporary reporting of roughly $157,000.

A second campaign exercised the same BabyDoge swapAndLiquify defect on 2023-06-21 in transaction 0xbaf3e4841614eca5480c63662b41cd058ee5c85dc69198b29e7ab63b84bc866c at block 29295011:86, by attacker 0xee6764ac7aa45ed52482e4320906fd75615ba1d1 through helper 0x9a6b926281b0c7bc4f775e81f42b13eda9c1c98e. It never called FarmZAP: the fee-exempt swap access was replaced by a PancakeV3 USDT/BUSD flash loan and a Venus vBNB borrow of 99463.293771243647112315 BNB. Its loss is merged here as the second asset component and the 2023-05-28 transaction remains the incident anchor; incidents/56/0xbaf3e4841614eca5480c63662b41cd058ee5c85dc69198b29e7ab63b84bc866c.json was removed in favour of this record.
